properties.name: Pleistocene Lake Konya
properties.note: Approximate, digitised from the basin described by Roberts (1983): late Pleistocene shore terraces at about 1005–1020 m around the Konya plain. Not a surveyed shoreline and not the modern playas.

properties.name: Lake Van high stand
properties.note: Approximate, a coarse outline larger than the modern lake for the late-glacial high stand discussed by Wick, Lemcke, and Sturm (2003). Not a digitised terrace and not the present shore.
